baseline.measured_open_case: published calls with one or more arguments paid the full compile/append ceremony

direct_path.outer_shape: proper call list with a symbol operator
direct_path.argument_conversion: self-evaluating values pass unchanged; exact unary quote contributes its quoted object
direct_path.action: nullary retains funcall; n-ary uses apply with the proven value list
direct_path.generation_binding: function-kind and funcall/apply consume the current published function cell

arity_authority.source: the published CodeObject header consumed by vm_arity_accepts
arity_authority.optional_arity: eligible when the value-form guard passes
arity_authority.rest_arity: eligible when the value-form guard passes
arity_authority.wrong_arity: the VM rejects it through the ordinary arity status
arity_authority.reason: a Lisp-side fixed/rest registry would be a second metadata truth and would not cover session-created entries

mandatory_fallbacks: argument variables other than nil and t

safety.compiler_path: the historical %c2-compile-form -> lcc-install branch remains the only fallback
safety.argument_semantics: the direct path is allowed only where argument evaluation is observationally identical to value extraction
safety.error_path: funcall/apply retain VM strict-arity and inner-status-wins handling

required_fixtures: published nullary bytecode call retains the established direct path
published fixed-arity call with fixnum values bypasses compile/install
published call with exact quote values bypasses compile/install and is byte-equivalent to compiled evaluation
optional and rest CodeObject arity remain governed by the VM
wrong arity reaches the VM arity rejection without compiling a wrapper
primitive, macro, undefined, special and malformed forms reach %c2-compile-form
direct and compiled paths agree for every admitted value class
prohibitions: no direct evaluation of variables or nested forms
no private arity table or cached function identity
no primitive or macro direct path
no weakening of CRC, wipe, journal, rollback or publish-last contracts
no hardware claim before the bundled S1 session
